answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 25368 Country: India Title: Which kind of bank could job perform? Question: which kind of bank could job perform Answer ID: 25368 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1530/1086/L=1431) A job of bank is lawful which does not involve receiving interest, paying interest, recording it and bearing witness to it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
